description.ko: CPU 설계 표와 실제 공개 소스를 분리한 목록. 실행 검증은 별도이다.
description.en: CPU design table rows and actual public source declarations, kept separate from execution evidence.

scope.builtin_support: Compiler/runtime providers are listed separately; matching a name is not implementation proof.
scope.extraction: Callable names in first cells of API tables; prose examples and operators are not counted as functions.

compiler_providers.role: Explicit CPU atomic declarations and ordering/result carriers
CPU lock/guard declaration provider when available; native foundation alone is not source support
Specialization and explicit compiler expression binding
Builtin scalar/collection operations and validated typed bindings
Lowering of typed operations; not proof of every catalog signature

catalog.name: Array.alignment
catalog.contract: Required native element alignment; not an external ABI declaration. | O(1)

catalog.name: Array.all
catalog.contract: Short-circuits; empty returns true. | O(N) worst case

catalog.name: Array.any
catalog.contract: Short-circuits; empty returns false. | O(N) worst case

catalog.name: Array.as_mut_slice
catalog.contract: Exclusive borrowed view; owner access is restricted until the reborrow ends. | O(1), no allocation

catalog.name: Array.as_slice
catalog.contract: Lifetime tied to owner; contiguous read view. | O(1), no allocation

catalog.name: Array.at
catalog.contract: Checked access with a diagnostic error; indexing operator spelling remains separate. | O(1)

catalog.name: Array.at_mut
catalog.signature: Array.at_mut(&mut Array<T, N> values, usize index)
catalog.contract: Checked exclusive access. | O(1)

catalog.name: Array.binary_search
catalog.signature: Array.binary_search(&Array<T, N> values, &T needle, Compare<T> compare)
catalog.contract: Requires sorted input and the same consistent total comparator; returns found or insertion index. | O(log N) comparisons

catalog.name: Array.byte_len
catalog.contract: Element representation bytes, N times size_of(T); does not include separately owned resources. | O(1); checked when the type is formed

catalog.name: Array.clone
catalog.contract: T: Clone; duplicates elements using their Clone contract; never promises recursive deep isolation. | O(N) clones; element allocations possible

catalog.name: Array.compare
catalog.signature: Array.compare(&Array<T, N> left, &Array<T, N> right, Compare<T> compare)
catalog.contract: Lexicographic total comparison; NaN needs an explicit total float comparator. | O(N) comparisons

catalog.name: Array.concat
catalog.signature: Array.concat(Array<T, N> a, Array<T, M> b)
catalog.contract: Compile-time sum and output layout must fit the target. | O(N+M) logical moves

catalog.name: Array.concat
catalog.signature: Array.concat(Array<T, N> left, Array<T, M> right)
catalog.contract: N+M and the output layout must be valid at compile time. | O(N+M) moves

catalog.name: Array.contains
catalog.contract: T: Eq; tests logical equality, not raw padding bytes. | O(N) equality calls

catalog.name: Array.copy
catalog.contract: T: Copy only; explicit aggregate duplication even when elements are simple scalars. | O(N) representation copies

catalog.name: Array.count
catalog.contract: Number of matching elements; bounded by N. | O(N) predicate calls

catalog.name: Array.default
catalog.contract: T: Default; constructs each element, not arbitrary zero bytes; partial output is cleaned on failure. | O(N) constructions

catalog.name: Array.element_size
catalog.contract: Native element representation size, including its internal padding; may be zero. | O(1)

catalog.name: Array.empty
catalog.contract: No element construction; valid without T: Default. | O(1); no element buffer allocation

catalog.name: Array.equal
catalog.contract: T: Eq; elementwise equality. | O(N) equality calls

catalog.name: Array.fill_clone
catalog.contract: T: Clone; basic guarantee: an error may leave a replaced prefix, but every slot stays initialized. | O(N) clone/drop work

catalog.name: Array.fill_copy
catalog.contract: T: Copy; overwrites every initialized element without changing N. | O(N) copies and old-element drops

catalog.name: Array.fill_with
catalog.signature: Array.fill_with(&mut Array<T, N> values, Make<T> make)
catalog.contract: Infallible replacement callback; every slot stays initialized. | O(N) callback/drop work

catalog.name: Array.find
catalog.contract: Read borrow of the first match; None when absent. | O(N) predicate calls

catalog.name: Array.first
catalog.contract: None for N=0. | O(1)

catalog.name: Array.first_mut
catalog.contract: Exclusive first-element borrow, or None. | O(1)

catalog.name: Array.flatten
catalog.contract: Static product checked at compile time; preserves row-major element order. | O(R*C) logical moves; elision possible

catalog.name: Array.fold
catalog.signature: Array.fold(&Array<T, N> values, A initial, Fold<A, T> step)
catalog.contract: Sequential left fold; callback chooses checked numeric semantics. | O(N) calls

catalog.name: Array.from_clone
catalog.contract: T: Clone; source unchanged; failure drops only successfully cloned output elements. | O(N) clone calls; element allocation possible

catalog.name: Array.from_copy
catalog.contract: T: Copy; repeats a valid value. Does not bit-copy an arbitrary owner. | O(N) scalar copies

catalog.name: Array.from_fn
catalog.signature: Array.from_fn(T, const usize N, Make<T> make)
catalog.contract: Infallible callback receives each usize index once in ascending order; zero length calls it zero times. | O(N) callback calls

catalog.name: Array.from_slice_clone
catalog.signature: Array.from_slice_clone(T, const usize N, Slice<T> source)
catalog.contract: T: Clone; checks exact length first; cleans partial output if cloning fails. | O(N) clone calls

catalog.name: Array.from_slice_copy
catalog.signature: Array.from_slice_copy(T, const usize N, Slice<T> source)
catalog.contract: T: Copy; source length must be N; source remains borrowed and unchanged. | O(N) copies

catalog.name: Array.from_values
catalog.signature: Array.from_values(T, const usize N, N owned T values)
catalog.contract: Consumes exactly N initialized values; arity/type mismatch is a compile-time error. | O(N) element moves

catalog.name: Array.get
catalog.contract: None outside [0,N); does not clone or move the element. | O(1)

catalog.name: Array.get_mut
catalog.signature: Array.get_mut(&mut Array<T, N> values, usize index)
catalog.contract: None out of bounds; returned borrow is exclusive. | O(1)

catalog.name: Array.into_box
catalog.contract: Moves owner into an explicit allocation; allocation failure returns original owner. | O(N) possible movement plus allocation

catalog.name: Array.into_iter
catalog.contract: Moves out elements; dropping iterator cleans every remaining element. | O(N) possible owner move; O(N) traversal

catalog.name: Array.into_vector
catalog.contract: Allocates destination before consuming elements; allocation/size failure returns intact original owner in Err. | O(N) moves plus allocation

catalog.name: Array.is_empty
catalog.contract: True exactly when N is zero. | O(1)

catalog.name: Array.is_sorted
catalog.contract: Checks adjacent ordering; empty/single-element arrays are sorted. | O(N) comparisons

catalog.name: Array.iter
catalog.contract: Yields read borrows; holds the owner borrow. | O(1) creation; O(N) traversal

catalog.name: Array.iter_mut
catalog.contract: Yields exclusive, disjoint element borrows; owner mutation stays suspended. | O(1) creation; O(N) traversal

catalog.name: Array.last
catalog.contract: None for N=0; never subtracts one from an empty length. | O(1)

catalog.name: Array.last_mut
catalog.contract: Exclusive last-element borrow, or None. | O(1)

catalog.name: Array.len
catalog.contract: Returns the compile-time extent N. | O(1)

catalog.name: Array.lower_bound
catalog.signature: Array.lower_bound(&Array<T, N> values, &T needle, Compare<T> compare)
catalog.contract: First not-less position under a consistent sorted ordering. | O(log N) comparisons

catalog.name: Array.map
catalog.signature: Array.map(Array<T, N> values, Transform<T, U> transform)
catalog.contract: Consumes elements in order; callback is infallible. | O(N) calls and moves

catalog.name: Array.map_ref
catalog.signature: Array.map_ref(&Array<T, N> values, RefTransform<T, U> transform)
catalog.contract: Callback receives read borrows; input owner remains available afterward. | O(N) calls

catalog.name: Array.max_len
catalog.contract: Target object/index upper bound, not an allocation promise; zero-sized elements still have a finite logical bound. | O(1)

catalog.name: Array.position
catalog.contract: First matching index; ascending callback order. | O(N) predicate calls

catalog.name: Array.replace
catalog.signature: Array.replace(&mut Array<T, N> values, usize index, T value)
catalog.contract: Returns the previous owner; failure preserves the array and returns the input. | O(1) element moves

catalog.name: Array.reshape
catalog.signature: Array.reshape(Array<T, N> values, const usize R, const usize C)
catalog.contract: Requires R*C=N with checked type-level arithmetic; no Tensor conversion or device transfer. | O(N) logical moves; elision possible

catalog.name: Array.reverse
catalog.contract: Reverses order in place. | O(N), no allocation

catalog.name: Array.rotate_left
catalog.signature: Array.rotate_left(&mut Array<T, N> values, usize count)
catalog.contract: Requires count <= N; empty accepts only zero; moves elements without cloning. | O(N), no allocation

catalog.name: Array.rotate_right
catalog.signature: Array.rotate_right(&mut Array<T, N> values, usize count)
catalog.contract: Same count contract as rotate_left. | O(N), no allocation

catalog.name: Array.rposition
catalog.contract: Last matching index; descending callback order. | O(N) predicate calls

catalog.name: Array.set
catalog.signature: Array.set(&mut Array<T, N> values, usize index, T value)
catalog.contract: Bounds failure returns the unused input value; success drops the replaced element. | O(1) element work plus Drop

catalog.name: Array.slice
catalog.signature: Array.slice(&Array<T, N> values, usize start, usize end)
catalog.contract: Requires start <= end <= N; half-open range. | O(1)

catalog.name: Array.slice_mut
catalog.signature: Array.slice_mut(&mut Array<T, N> values, usize start, usize end)
catalog.contract: Same bounds; exclusive permission is reborrowed, not duplicated. | O(1)

catalog.name: Array.sort
catalog.signature: Array.sort(&mut Array<T, N> values, Compare<T> compare)
catalog.contract: Stable sort; reserves scratch before reordering. Comparator failure/termination can leave reordered but valid elements. | O(N log N) comparisons; scratch may allocate

catalog.name: Array.sort_unstable
catalog.signature: Array.sort_unstable(&mut Array<T, N> values, Compare<T> compare)
catalog.contract: Unstable in-place sort; infallible consistent total comparator required; no unchanged-order guarantee on interruption. | O(N log N) comparisons; no heap scratch

catalog.name: Array.split_owned
catalog.signature: Array.split_owned(Array<T, N> values, const usize K)
catalog.contract: Requires K <= N at compile time; consumes the original owner. | O(N) moves

catalog.name: Array.swap
catalog.signature: Array.swap(&mut Array<T, N> values, usize a, usize b)
catalog.contract: Checks both indices before changing either; equal indices are valid. | O(1) element swaps

catalog.name: Array.swap_arrays
catalog.signature: Array.swap_arrays(&mut Array<T, N> left, &mut Array<T, N> right)
catalog.contract: Exchanges all elements between disjoint owners; not a constant-time pointer swap. | O(N) element swaps

catalog.name: Array.to_vector_clone
catalog.contract: T: Clone; explicit allocated duplicate, source preserved. | O(N) clones plus allocation

catalog.name: Array.transpose
catalog.contract: Reorders owned elements; this is not a zero-copy strided view. | O(R*C) moves

catalog.name: Array.try_fold
catalog.signature: Array.try_fold(&Array<T, N> values, A initial, TryFold<A, T, E> step)
catalog.contract: Stops on Err; input array remains borrowed, external callback effects remain. | O(N) calls

catalog.name: Array.try_from_fn
catalog.signature: Array.try_from_fn(T, const usize N, TryMake<T, E> make)
catalog.contract: Stops at first callback Err; initialized prefix is dropped safely; external callback effects remain. | O(N) calls; no independent array buffer

catalog.name: Array.try_map
catalog.signature: Array.try_map(Array<T, N> values, TryTransform<T, U, E> transform)
catalog.contract: On Err, drops partial output and all unconsumed source elements; source is not reconstructed. | O(N) calls and cleanup

catalog.name: Array.try_map_ref
catalog.signature: Array.try_map_ref(&Array<T, N> values, TryRefTransform<T, U, E> transform)
catalog.contract: Source preserved; partially initialized output is cleaned on Err. | O(N) calls

catalog.name: Array.unzip
catalog.contract: Separates pair fields without cloning. | O(N) moves

catalog.name: Array.upper_bound
catalog.signature: Array.upper_bound(&Array<T, N> values, &T needle, Compare<T> compare)
catalog.contract: First greater position under a consistent sorted ordering. | O(log N) comparisons

catalog.name: Array.zip
catalog.signature: Array.zip(Array<T, N> a, Array<U, N> b)
catalog.contract: Lengths agree in the types; each output pair owns its fields. | O(N) moves

catalog.name: Array.zip
catalog.signature: Array.zip(Array<T, N> left, Array<U, N> right)
catalog.contract: Same compile-time length; pairs ownership, not aliases. | O(N) moves

catalog.name: Atomic.capabilities
catalog.contract: Describe load/store, RMW, wait, floating extension, and memory scope separately.

catalog.name: Atomic.checked_fetch_add
catalog.signature: Atomic.checked_fetch_add(&Atomic<T> cell, T value, MemoryOrder order)
catalog.contract: Integer-only CAS loop; overflow leaves cell unchanged at the failed attempt; no bounded retry promise.

catalog.name: Atomic.checked_fetch_sub
catalog.signature: Atomic.checked_fetch_sub(&Atomic<T> cell, T value, MemoryOrder order)
catalog.contract: Integer-only checked subtraction loop; arithmetic failure performs no write by this call.

catalog.name: Atomic.compare_exchange
catalog.signature: Atomic.compare_exchange(&Atomic<T> cell, T expected, T desired, MemoryOrder success, MemoryOrder failure)
catalog.contract: Mismatch returns changed=false and observed value; failure order must be Relaxed, Acquire, or SeqCst.

catalog.name: Atomic.compare_exchange_weak
catalog.signature: Atomic.compare_exchange_weak(&Atomic<T> cell, T expected, T desired, MemoryOrder success, MemoryOrder failure)
catalog.contract: May report changed=false even when equal; use a correct retry protocol.

catalog.name: Atomic.compiler_fence
catalog.contract: Order the declared same-thread/interrupt compiler profile; not an interthread hardware fence.

catalog.name: Atomic.fence
catalog.contract: Acquire, Release, AcqRel, or SeqCst only; Relaxed is invalid.

catalog.name: Atomic.fetch_add
catalog.signature: Atomic.fetch_add(&Atomic<T> cell, T value, MemoryOrder order)
catalog.contract: Integer-only modular addition; return old value; wrapping is part of this named contract.

catalog.name: Atomic.fetch_and
catalog.signature: Atomic.fetch_and(&Atomic<T> cell, T mask, MemoryOrder order)
catalog.contract: Integer/bool bitwise update; return old value.

catalog.name: Atomic.fetch_max
catalog.signature: Atomic.fetch_max(&Atomic<T> cell, T value, MemoryOrder order)
catalog.contract: Integer signedness determines comparison; return old value.

catalog.name: Atomic.fetch_min
catalog.signature: Atomic.fetch_min(&Atomic<T> cell, T value, MemoryOrder order)
catalog.contract: Integer signedness determines comparison; return old value.

catalog.name: Atomic.fetch_nand
catalog.signature: Atomic.fetch_nand(&Atomic<T> cell, T mask, MemoryOrder order)
catalog.contract: Integer/bool complemented intersection; return old value.

catalog.name: Atomic.fetch_or
catalog.signature: Atomic.fetch_or(&Atomic<T> cell, T mask, MemoryOrder order)
catalog.contract: Integer/bool bitwise update; return old value.

catalog.name: Atomic.fetch_sub
catalog.signature: Atomic.fetch_sub(&Atomic<T> cell, T value, MemoryOrder order)
catalog.contract: Integer-only modular subtraction; return old value.

catalog.name: Atomic.fetch_update
catalog.signature: Atomic.fetch_update(&Atomic<T> cell, MemoryOrder success, MemoryOrder failure, Update<T> update)
catalog.contract: Callback may run repeatedly; None aborts an attempt; external callback effects are not transactional.

catalog.name: Atomic.fetch_xor
catalog.signature: Atomic.fetch_xor(&Atomic<T> cell, T mask, MemoryOrder order)
catalog.contract: Integer/bool bitwise update; return old value.

catalog.name: Atomic.get_mut
catalog.contract: Non-atomic exclusive access only when no competing access or live conflicting atomic view exists.

catalog.name: Atomic.into_inner
catalog.contract: Extract through unique ownership; no concurrent cell references may remain.

catalog.name: Atomic.is_lock_free
catalog.contract: Query the selected implementation; not a universal property or wait-freedom promise.

catalog.name: Atomic.is_supported
catalog.contract: Compile-time capability query for this cell type and selected execution target.

catalog.name: Atomic.load
catalog.contract: Accept Relaxed, Acquire, or SeqCst; reject store-only orders.

catalog.name: Atomic.new
catalog.contract: Construct an inline supported cell; no heap allocation; cell itself is not Copy.

catalog.name: Atomic.notify_all
catalog.contract: Wake eligible waiters; no fairness or completion guarantee.

catalog.name: Atomic.notify_one
catalog.contract: Wake an eligible waiter if supported; not a substitute for publishing state.

catalog.name: Atomic.required_alignment
catalog.contract: Target atomic-cell alignment; may exceed scalar alignment.

catalog.name: Atomic.saturating_fetch_add
catalog.signature: Atomic.saturating_fetch_add(&Atomic<T> cell, T value, MemoryOrder order)
catalog.contract: Integer-only saturation; may use a retry loop; return prior value on success.

catalog.name: Atomic.saturating_fetch_sub
catalog.signature: Atomic.saturating_fetch_sub(&Atomic<T> cell, T value, MemoryOrder order)
catalog.contract: Integer-only saturation; no general wait-free guarantee.

catalog.name: Atomic.store
catalog.signature: Atomic.store(&Atomic<T> cell, T value, MemoryOrder order)
catalog.contract: Accept Relaxed, Release, or SeqCst; reject load-only orders.

catalog.name: Atomic.swap
catalog.signature: Atomic.swap(&Atomic<T> cell, T value, MemoryOrder order)
catalog.contract: Atomic read-modify-write with any of the five orders; return old value.

catalog.name: Atomic.valid_failure_order
catalog.contract: Accept Relaxed, Acquire, SeqCst; Release and AcqRel are invalid.

catalog.name: Atomic.valid_fence_order
catalog.contract: Accept all named orders except Relaxed; no fence is executed.

catalog.name: Atomic.valid_load_order
catalog.contract: Accept Relaxed, Acquire, SeqCst; pure validation, no memory operation.

catalog.name: Atomic.valid_store_order
catalog.contract: Accept Relaxed, Release, SeqCst; pure validation.

catalog.name: Atomic.wait
catalog.signature: Atomic.wait(&Atomic<T> cell, T expected, MemoryOrder order)
catalog.contract: Host capability only; may wake spuriously; caller must recheck its predicate.

catalog.name: Atomic.wait_timeout
catalog.signature: Atomic.wait_timeout(&Atomic<T> cell, T expected, Duration timeout, MemoryOrder order)
catalog.contract: Host wait capability; timeout and spurious wake are explicit outcomes.

catalog.name: Boolean.all
catalog.contract: True for an empty slice; reads in order and stops at the first false. | O(n) worst case

catalog.name: Boolean.and
catalog.contract: Both arguments are evaluated before the call; true exactly when both are true. | O(1)

catalog.name: Boolean.any
catalog.contract: False for an empty slice; reads in order and stops at the first true. | O(n) worst case

catalog.name: Boolean.compare
catalog.contract: Proposed total order: false precedes true. This is not an integer coercion. | O(1)

catalog.name: Boolean.count_true
catalog.contract: Counts true elements; result cannot exceed the valid slice length. | O(n)

catalog.name: Boolean.equal
catalog.contract: Equality of the two logical values. | O(1)

catalog.name: Boolean.format
catalog.contract: Returns lowercase true or false as an owning UTF-8 string. | O(1) bytes; explicit allocation

catalog.name: Boolean.format_into
catalog.contract: Writes 4 or 5 ASCII bytes; no terminator. Checks capacity first and leaves output unchanged on insufficient space. | O(1), no allocation

catalog.name: Boolean.from_integer
catalog.contract: Only integer 0 and 1 are accepted; every other value is InvalidRepresentation. | O(1)

catalog.name: Boolean.from_nonzero
catalog.contract: Explicit integer truth conversion: zero is false and every nonzero integer is true. | O(1)

catalog.name: Boolean.not
catalog.contract: Logical complement. | O(1)

catalog.name: Boolean.ok_or
catalog.contract: True returns Ok(Unit.value()); false moves error. An unused eager error is destroyed. | O(1) + possible drop

catalog.name: Boolean.ok_or_else
catalog.contract: Constructs an error only when false. | O(1) + optional callback

catalog.name: Boolean.or
catalog.contract: Both arguments are evaluated before the call; true when at least one is true. | O(1)

catalog.name: Boolean.parse
catalog.contract: Accepts the complete lowercase tokens true and false only; no trimming, numeric aliases, or locale rules. | O(length), no allocation

catalog.name: Boolean.select
catalog.signature: Boolean.select(bool condition, T yes, T no)
catalog.contract: Eagerly constructed alternatives; moves the selected value and destroys the unselected value once. | O(1) selection + drop cost

catalog.name: Boolean.then
catalog.contract: Calls make once only when true; otherwise returns None. No speculative observable callback evaluation. | O(1) + optional callback

catalog.name: Boolean.then_some
catalog.contract: The value is eager; false destroys it and returns None. | O(1) + possible drop

catalog.name: Boolean.to_integer
catalog.contract: T must be an integer type; false maps to 0 and true to 1 exactly. | O(1)

catalog.name: Boolean.xor
catalog.contract: True exactly when the arguments differ. | O(1)

catalog.name: Box.allocation_bytes
catalog.contract: Payload allocation request size; excludes allocator bookkeeping.

catalog.name: Box.array_as_mut_slice
catalog.contract: Exclusive fixed-extent borrow; no ownership transfer.

catalog.name: Box.array_as_slice
catalog.contract: Borrow the initialized fixed extent; O(1), no allocation.

catalog.name: Box.array_from_fn
catalog.signature: Box.array_from_fn(T, const usize N, MakeAt<T> make)
catalog.contract: Construct directly into reserved storage; finalize initialized prefix on unwind.

catalog.name: Box.array_repeat_clone
catalog.contract: T: Clone; clean partially cloned output on failure.

catalog.name: Box.array_repeat_copy
catalog.contract: T: Copy; explicit O(N) copies and allocation.

catalog.name: Box.array_try_from_fn
catalog.signature: Box.array_try_from_fn(T, const usize N, TryMakeAt<T, E> make)
catalog.contract: Index builder failure cleans the initialized prefix and records the callback error.

catalog.name: Box.as_mut
catalog.contract: Exclusive borrow; owner movement, extraction, and conflicting access stay suspended.

catalog.name: Box.as_ref
catalog.contract: Borrow the initialized value; O(1), lifetime bounded by owner.

catalog.name: Box.clone
catalog.contract: T: Clone; allocate independent storage; clone failure preserves source.

catalog.name: Box.compare
catalog.contract: Compare values using an explicit consistent comparator; no implicit pointer order.

catalog.name: Box.copy
catalog.contract: T: Copy; allocate independent storage and copy the value.

catalog.name: Box.default
catalog.contract: T: Default; allocate and construct one value; expose failure.

catalog.name: Box.equal
catalog.contract: T: Eq; compare pointee values; add user comparison cost.

catalog.name: Box.flatten
catalog.contract: Move out the inner box and destroy outer storage; no inner-value clone.

catalog.name: Box.from_array
catalog.contract: Allocate fixed array storage; returned allocation failure preserves the original array.

catalog.name: Box.from_fn
catalog.contract: Reserve before calling the one-shot constructor; no large temporary is required.

catalog.name: Box.from_vector
catalog.contract: Box the vector handle; this may add an allocation, and failure returns the vector.

catalog.name: Box.into_array
catalog.contract: Move the inline array out; release heap storage, with O(N) payload-move cost.

catalog.name: Box.into_dyn
catalog.contract: Chosen conversion: move the concrete box into the target-inferred interface owner. T must implement that interface. No additional allocation, payload clone or device transfer; preserve concrete cleanup and borrowed-source lifetimes.

catalog.name: Box.into_inner
catalog.contract: Move out value and release allocation; no payload clone.

catalog.name: Box.into_shared
catalog.contract: May allocate shared control storage; failure returns the original box.

catalog.name: Box.into_vector
catalog.contract: Move out vector ownership and free only the outer box allocation.

catalog.name: Box.map
catalog.contract: Preallocate output before consuming T; allocation failure returns source; unwind does not roll back callback effects.

catalog.name: Box.new
catalog.contract: Allocate initialized unique storage; size or allocation failure returns the unused value.

catalog.name: Box.payload_alignment
catalog.contract: Required target alignment of T, not a universal C ABI assertion.

catalog.name: Box.payload_size
catalog.contract: Native size of T, excluding allocator and separately owned resources; compile-time metadata.

catalog.name: Box.replace
catalog.contract: Move out old value and install initialized replacement; no new allocation.

catalog.name: Box.same_allocation
catalog.contract: Compare allocation identities, not value equality or an aliasing permission.

catalog.name: Box.swap
catalog.contract: Swap ownership handles under distinct exclusive borrows; O(1), no payload clone.

catalog.name: Box.try_from_fn
catalog.contract: Reserve then construct once; callback failure cleans allocated storage.

catalog.name: Box.try_map
catalog.signature: Box.try_map(Box<T> owner, TryTransform<T, U, E> transform)
catalog.contract: Preflight failure returns owner; a callback error after consuming T cannot reconstruct it.

catalog.name: Box.vector_as_mut_slice
catalog.contract: Exclusive element view; no vector growth is permitted through this slice.

catalog.name: Box.vector_as_slice
catalog.contract: Borrow the vector’s initialized elements; nested ownership remains intact.

catalog.name: Byte.allocate
catalog.contract: Allocate length zero-initialized bytes; reject size overflow and allocation failure.

catalog.name: Byte.append
catalog.contract: Move source contents into destination; source becomes empty after success; may allocate.

catalog.name: Byte.bit_and
catalog.contract: Intersect set bits; no numeric arithmetic.

catalog.name: Byte.bit_and_not
catalog.contract: Keep left bits absent from right.

catalog.name: Byte.bit_length
catalog.contract: Return zero for zero, otherwise highest set position plus one.

catalog.name: Byte.bit_not
catalog.contract: Invert exactly eight bits.

catalog.name: Byte.bit_or
catalog.contract: Union set bits.

catalog.name: Byte.bit_width
catalog.contract: Return eight value bits; constant, no allocation.

catalog.name: Byte.bit_xor
catalog.contract: Toggle positions that differ.

catalog.name: Byte.byte_width
catalog.contract: Return one eight-bit storage byte; no universal ABI promise.

catalog.name: Byte.capacity
catalog.contract: Return reserved storage capacity without moving ownership.

catalog.name: Byte.chunks
catalog.contract: Require nonzero width; borrow chunks including a shorter tail.

catalog.name: Byte.clear
catalog.contract: Set length to zero, retain capacity; no secure-erasure guarantee.

catalog.name: Byte.clear_bit
catalog.contract: Return a copy with the selected bit cleared.

catalog.name: Byte.compare_bits
catalog.contract: Order by unsigned pattern value; not an implicit arithmetic conversion.

catalog.name: Byte.compare_lexicographic
catalog.contract: Compare unsigned byte values and then lengths; no text collation or allocation.

catalog.name: Byte.copy_from
catalog.contract: Require equal lengths and nonconflicting borrows; copy initialized bytes.

catalog.name: Byte.copy_within
catalog.signature: Byte.copy_within(MutSlice<byte> buffer, Range<usize> source, usize destination)
catalog.contract: Checked overlap-safe movement within one exclusive buffer; no allocation.

catalog.name: Byte.count_ones
catalog.contract: Count set bits, from zero through eight.

catalog.name: Mutex.replace

catalog.name: Mutex.set

catalog.name: Mutex.try_lock

catalog.name: Mutex.with_policy

catalog.name: Optional.copy

catalog.name: Optional.equal

catalog.name: Optional.filter

catalog.name: Optional.flatten

catalog.name: Optional.insert

catalog.name: Optional.inspect

catalog.name: Optional.into_iter

catalog.name: Optional.is_none

catalog.name: Optional.is_none_or

catalog.name: Optional.is_some

catalog.name: Optional.is_some_and

catalog.name: Optional.iter

catalog.name: Optional.iter_mut

catalog.name: Optional.map

catalog.name: Optional.map_ref

catalog.name: Optional.none

catalog.name: Optional.ok_or

catalog.name: Optional.ok_or_else

catalog.name: Optional.or

catalog.name: Optional.or_else

catalog.name: Optional.replace

catalog.name: Optional.some

catalog.name: Optional.unwrap_or_else

source.name: Array.from_copy
source.signature: Array.from_copy(&Array<T, N> values) -> Array<T, N> where T implements Copy
source.availability_note: Borrow a fixed-size array and copy its Copy elements into a new inline array. Arrays remain move-only; explicit type arguments and the older fill-constructor catalog form are not supplied by this overload.

source.name: Float.to_bits
source.availability_note: Exact, nonallocating bit reinterpretation: f16/bf16 pair with u16, f32 with u32, f64 with u64. from_bits requires an explicit float type; signed or pointer-sized integers are not counterparts. Numeric conversion and native-endian serialization are separate.

source.name: Char.from_u32
source.availability_note: Pure, nonallocating scalar conversion. from_u32 accepts only Unicode scalar values, excluding surrogates and values above U+10FFFF; InvalidScalar retains the original u32. Unassigned characters and noncharacters remain valid scalars. No UTF decoding or Unicode property lookup is performed.

source.name: Char.to_u32
